cues.text: The Earth Empire was founded in 2125.
Its drive for power, expansion, and conquest would lead it on a two-hundred-year campaign across the galaxy.
Within twenty years of the Empire’s birth, more than a dozen races had been annexed and put to work building the Imperial regime.
But revolution would eventually bring the Empire to the brink of collapse, opening the way for subject worlds to break away and reclaim their independence.
Of those powers that emerged from the chaos, the Klingons built the strongest empire, swiftly conquering more than half of former human territory.
Without the firm hand of the Earth Empire, the galaxy has since degenerated into anarchy.
Empires rise and fall with alarming regularity.
Humanity and the Klingons remain locked in a bloody interstellar war, while countless other governments struggle to hold what territory remains under their control.
The galaxy now waits for a power strong enough to impose order once again.
For a firm hand to rise...
